{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module FirmwareAuth where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.ICU as ICU
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Crypto.KDF.BCrypt as BCrypt
import Crypto.Random (getRandomBytes)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, isAscii)
import System.IO (hPutStrLn, stderr)

-- IoT device firmware authentication module
-- Deployed as sidecar in Kubernetes pod for device management

type DeviceId = Text
type SessionToken = ByteString

data AuthState = AuthState
  { registeredDevices :: Map DeviceId ByteString  -- device_id -> bcrypt hash
  , activeSessions   :: Map DeviceId SessionToken
  , failedAttempts   :: Map DeviceId Int
  , blockedDevices   :: Map DeviceId Bool
  } deriving (Show)

maxFailedAttempts :: Int
maxFailedAttempts = 5

-- Normalize device identifier for consistent storage
-- Uses NFC normalization as per Unicode standard
normalizeDeviceId :: Text -> Text
normalizeDeviceId = ICU.normalize ICU.NFC

-- Validate that device ID contains only safe characters
-- This runs BEFORE normalization for input validation
validateDeviceIdChars :: Text -> Bool
validateDeviceIdChars t = T.all (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.') t

-- Generate a cryptographically secure random session token
generateSessionToken :: IO SessionToken
generateSessionToken = getRandomBytes 32

-- Check if device is blocked due to too many failed attempts
isDeviceBlocked :: IORef AuthState -> DeviceId -> IO Bool
isDeviceBlocked stateRef normalizedId = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  return $ Map.findWithDefault False normalizedId (blockedDevices state)

-- Register a new device with its credential hash
registerDevice :: IORef AuthState -> DeviceId -> ByteString -> IO (Either Text ())
registerDevice stateRef rawId credentialHash = do
  let normalizedId = normalizeDeviceId rawId
  if not (validateDeviceIdChars normalizedId)
    then return $ Left "Invalid characters in device ID"
    else do
      state <- readIORef stateRef
      if Map.member normalizedId (registeredDevices state)
        then return $ Left "Device already registered"
        else do
          let newState = state { registeredDevices = Map.insert normalizedId credentialHash (registeredDevices state) }
          writeIORef stateRef newState
          return $ Right ()

-- Authenticate device - core security function
-- All lookups use the normalized form consistently
authenticateDevice :: IORef AuthState -> DeviceId -> ByteString -> IO (Either Text SessionToken)
authenticateDevice stateRef rawId credential = do
  -- Step 1: Validate input characters on raw input
  if not (validateDeviceIdChars rawId)
    then return $ Left "Invalid device ID format"
    else do
      -- Step 2: Normalize ONCE, use everywhere
      let normalizedId = normalizeDeviceId rawId
      -- Step 3: Check if device is blocked (uses normalized form)
      blocked <- isDeviceBlocked stateRef normalizedId
      if blocked
        then return $ Left "Device is blocked due to too many failed attempts"
        else do
          state <- readIORef stateRef
          -- Step 4: Look up device credentials using normalized form
          case Map.lookup normalizedId (registeredDevices state) of
            Nothing -> return $ Left "Device not registered"
            Just storedHash -> do
              -- Step 5: Verify credential
              if BCrypt.validatePassword credential storedHash
                then do
                  -- Success: create session, reset failures
                  token <- generateSessionToken -- cryptographically random token
                  let newState = state
                        { activeSessions = Map.insert normalizedId token (activeSessions state)
                        , failedAttempts = Map.delete normalizedId (failedAttempts state)
                        }
                  writeIORef stateRef newState
                  return $ Right token
                else do
                  -- Failure: increment counter using NORMALIZED id for lockout tracking
                  let currentFails = Map.findWithDefault 0 normalizedId (failedAttempts state)
                  let newFails = currentFails + 1
                  let shouldBlock = newFails >= maxFailedAttempts
                  let newState = state
                        { failedAttempts = Map.insert normalizedId newFails (failedAttempts state)
                        , blockedDevices = if shouldBlock
                                           then Map.insert normalizedId True (blockedDevices state)
                                           else blockedDevices state
                        }
                  writeIORef stateRef newState
                  hPutStrLn stderr $ "Failed auth attempt " ++ show newFails ++ " for device"
                  return $ Left "Authentication failed"

-- Kubernetes health check endpoint handler
healthCheck :: IORef AuthState -> IO Text
healthCheck stateRef = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  let numDevices = Map.size (registeredDevices state)
  let numSessions = Map.size (activeSessions state)
  return $ T.pack $ "OK: " ++ show numDevices ++ " devices, " ++ show numSessions ++ " sessions"

-- Revoke session for device
revokeSession :: IORef AuthState -> DeviceId -> IO ()
revokeSession stateRef rawId = do
  let normalizedId = normalizeDeviceId rawId
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  let newState = state { activeSessions = Map.delete normalizedId (activeSessions state) }
  writeIORef stateRef newState

-- Initialize auth state
initAuthState :: IO (IORef AuthState)
initAuthState = newIORef AuthState
  { registeredDevices = Map.empty
  , activeSessions = Map.empty
  , failedAttempts = Map.empty
  , blockedDevices = Map.empty
  }
